newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD WIN PUTS PSV TITLE ON HOLD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD WIN PUTS PSV TITLE ON HOLD.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven's Dutch title claims were delayed when Feyenoord thrashed neighbours Sparta Rotterdam 6-1 on Monday.
With two matches remaining, PSV lead with 74 points, four more than Feyenoord. The Eindhoven side need one more point to claim their 14th championship.
Feyenoord's victory, which matched PSV's equally emphatic 6-1 win over Utrecht on Saturday, contained two first half goals for Gaston Taument, who moves to Benfica next season, and Pablo Sanchez.
Jean Paul van Gastel and Giovanni van Bronckhorst completed the scoring after the break.
Feyenoord's win left them second at worst and in the European Cup next season.
